checklist.note: All findings correlated: Rx drop coinciding with SC-05 reopening, OTDR shows ~2.6 dB loss at ~18.75 km

args.evidence: Rx power fell from ~-10.6 dBm to ~-13.4 dBm after 2026-10-22 when SC-05 was reopened. Measured A-TX 1.24 dBm, B-ODF -6.29 dBm giving link loss 7.53 dB vs commissioning 4.72 dB. OTDR at 1550 nm from A shows a non-reflective 2.59 dB loss at 18.753 km, with backscatter drop visible in trace at ~18.75 km, consistent with macrobend near SC-05 at 18.254 km route km. Embedded OTDR also shows large loss near same location. Connectors clean, transmitter normal, attenuator loss ~7.18 dB as expected.
